column3: “Reign wisely” combines reigning and acting wisely.
“He had banished” replaces “I banished”; “other” and “once more” are supplied.
“The people of Jerusalem” identifies the city referred to by a feminine possessive.
“False hopes” specifies making the hearers vain; “minds” renders hearts.
“Of them” supplies a restriction; “obeyed” renders hearing.
“With their message” is supplied after running.
“Through the worship of” specifies the reference to Baal.
“Words they attribute to Me” expands the straightforward “My words.”
